profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I am a strong backend Java engineer with a proven track record of building high quality, low-latency, high-performance, and multi-threaded cloud software and applications to solve complex enterprise challenges. My experience spans across retail trading systems, ad tech, e-commerce, and, data recovery where I’ve designed and developed key features that directly impact performance and scalability. 
I bring a deep understanding of concurrent programming and system architecture, with a focus on delivering robust and efficient solutions.

positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States · Hybrid

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States · Remote
positions.description:
Software Engineer on the Transaction Tower of Enhanced transactions & Merchant Insights team in Capital One.  
Led design and development efforts for data pipeline and ETL to process 3rd party and load into postgresql database.
Build out AWS Lambda to support Automation Services
Developed Rest API with Java 11 &  spring boot processing raw merchant data and serving enhanced merchant data, and brand and location info to API consumers.
Architected Application using AWS Serverless Architecture with Kafka Publishers and Consumers for request and response processing 
 Deploy to AWS services with jenkins and terraform to minimize managed components and increase automation
Utilize services such as Cloudformation, ALB, ECS, R53, Lambda, CloudWatch, Redis, ElastiCache, RDS for application architecture to support scalability, high availablity

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Contributed to legacy web service for ad tech and click streaming in C#/.NET.
Built out AWS Lambda and Step Function architecture to automate periodic E-reporting as well as true up ledger processing.
Provisioned a new revenue stream using AWS Athena to connect Kayak Sponsored Listings as a new publisher and set up click tracking via beacon.

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description: Managed data recovery code for VMware hypervisor to backup disk for IBM Spectrum Protect Plus. Microservice architecture built in Java Spring Boot. Held face to face meetings to access requirements for sprints and client goals. Implemented these requirements to satisfy customer requests. Improve back up features with round robin proxy serving for back up servers as well as implemented a cache to store hypervisors to increase backup time by over 70%.

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description: Contribute to Java Springboot API to serve documents for website. Used React.js to build out webpage for API for serving documents to less tech proficient employees.
